THE 2026 RAM HEAVY DUTY. Built with relentless capability and unyielding power, the Ram Heavy Duty
lineup is built to tackle the toughest requests. Whether you’re hauling heavy loads to the jobsite or towing
trailers or big boats, Ram 2500 and 3500 trucks deliver. Advanced technology, bold styling, refined interiors
and the confidence that comes from powertrains like the available High-Output 6.7L Cummins® Turbo Diesel
engine with TorqueFlite® HD eight-speed automatic transmission prove that strength and sophistication
can go hand in hand. Mile after mile, task after task, this lineup proves that Nothing Stops Ram.
Properly secure all cargo. Always tow within vehicle's capacity.
